How we teach

Each session is about 2 hours: a short concept briefing, then guided labs, then a break-it-and-fix-it challenge. The design target is roughly 25% theory and 75% hands-on work, with weekly assessments and a readiness checkpoint at the end of every phase.

Prerequisites: a laptop with 8 GB RAM (16 GB preferred), a basic comfort with computers, and an AWS and GitHub account (setup help provided). No prior DevOps knowledge is required.

Day 0 to Day 90

90-Day Curriculum

Ten phases, each ending with a checkpoint. Open a phase, then a day, to see the lab, assignment and interview focus.

constructor() { const allDays: DayEntry[] = this.dayData.split('\n').map((l, i) => { const [t, lab, hw, q, tp] = l.split('|'); return { n: i, t, lab, hw, q, tp, hidden: false }; }); this.phases = this.phasesMeta.map(([name, from, to, goal], i) => ({ name, from, to, goal, days: allDays.slice(from, to + 1), open: i === 0, hidden: false })); } @HostListener('window:scroll') onScroll(): void { this.showBackToTop = window.scrollY > 400; } toggleNav(): void { this.navOpen = !this.navOpen; } closeNav(): void { this.navOpen = false; } onSearch(): void { const v = this.searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim(); this.phases.forEach(ph => { let any = false; ph.days.forEach(d => { const text = `${d.t} ${d.lab} ${d.hw} ${d.q} ${d.tp || ''}`.toLowerCase(); d.hidden = !!v && !text.includes(v); if (!d.hidden) any = true; }); ph.hidden = !!v && !any; if (v && any) ph.open = true; }); } onSubmit(): void { const f = this.form; const body = `Name: ${f.name}\nPhone: ${f.phone}\nExperience: ${f.experience}\nRole: ${f.role}\nBatch: ${f.batch}\n\n${f.message}`; this.formStatus = 'Opening your email app to send this enquiry...'; window.location.href = `mailto:${this.email}?subject=${encodeURIComponent('Training enquiry from ' + f.name)}&body=${encodeURIComponent(body)}`; } scrollToTop(): void { window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' }); } }
